requirements.title: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related discipline
requirements.description: Candidate should have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related discipline.
requirements.explanation: Vipul's CV indicates a strong background in data engineering, which typically requires a degree in Computer Science or a related field, although the exact degree is not specified.

requirements.title: Familiarity with at least one programming language
requirements.description: Candidate should be familiar with at least one programming language such as Python, Java, or C.
requirements.explanation: Vipul is proficient in Python, SQL, and PySpark, which meets and exceeds the requirement of familiarity with at least one programming language.

requirements.title: Basic understanding of software development principles
requirements.description: Candidate should have a basic understanding of software development principles.
requirements.explanation: While Vipul's experience is more focused on data engineering than general software development, the skills in data pipeline design and optimization indirectly demonstrate a basic understanding of software development principles.

requirements.title: Good communication skills and willingness to learn
requirements.description: Candidate should have good communication skills and a willingness to learn.
requirements.explanation: Vipul's cover letter expresses a clear willingness to learn and contribute to team success, and his collaboration with analysts and data scientists suggests good communication skills.

wishes.title: Experience in a specific software development role
wishes.description: It is beneficial if the candidate has experience in a specific software development role.
wishes.explanation: Vipul's experience is primarily in data engineering rather than traditional software development roles, which does not directly align with the typical responsibilities of a software developer.
